title: Authentication and Protected Routes
description: Learn how to implement user authentication and protect routes in React applications to secure content and manage user sessions.

lessons.title: Introduction to Authentication
lessons.content: Authentication verifies user identity, allowing secure access to specific parts of an app based on login status.

lessons.title: Understanding JWT (JSON Web Tokens)
lessons.content: JWTs are compact tokens used to securely transmit user identity information between client and server.

lessons.title: Setting Up Authentication Backend (Overview)
lessons.content: Authentication requires a backend API that supports login, signup, token issuance, and validation (e.g., using Node.js/Express).

lessons.title: Login Form and Authentication Flow
Storing Tokens Securely
lessons.content: Tokens can be stored in localStorage or cookies. Consider security risks and prefer HttpOnly cookies for sensitive applications.

lessons.title: Creating a Private Route Component
Protecting Routes with React Router
lessons.content:
```jsx
// Usage in Routes
<Routes>
  <Route path="/dashboard" element={<PrivateRoute><Dashboard /></PrivateRoute>} />
  <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
</Routes>
```

lessons.title: Implementing Logout Functionality
Handling Token Expiry and Refresh
lessons.content: Tokens may expire; implement refresh token flows or prompt users to re-login to maintain secure sessions.

lessons.title: Third-Party Authentication (OAuth, Firebase)
lessons.content: Many apps use OAuth providers (Google, Facebook) or services like Firebase Authentication to simplify login and secure user management.
